recommended_operating.conditions: 12 V DC permanent magnet motor, intermittent duty
typical at 12 V, 50 psi, 0.5 GPM (highest current in the table)
built-in pressure switch shut-off 55 psi (3.8 bar) +/- 2 psi
built-in pressure switch re-start 40 psi (2.8 bar) +/- 2 psi

pins.name: Red +
pins.notes: Motor lead, 16 AWG, 10 in (25 cm) red, positive. Lead numbering 1/2 is not in the datasheet (assigned here for mapping only).

pins.name: Black
pins.notes: Motor lead, 16 AWG, 13 in (33 cm) black, return (to the low-side switch in this design).

layout_notes.text: Motor protection: thermal overload with automatic restart (the pump can stop and restart by itself; firmware stall/overcurrent logic must tolerate it).
Built-in pressure switch: the pump stops by itself at 55 psi and restarts at 40 psi; the board sees the load open/close independently of the switch command.

gaps: Off-board load: no inrush (start-up) current and no locked-rotor/stall current in the data sheet. Note N-20261110-003 already says they must be measured.
Operating voltage range (min/max) not given; only '12V DC' nominal (p1). Performance table is at 12 V only (p2).
Duty cycle limit for 'intermittent duty' not quantified (p1).
Current values are typical (performance table and curve, p2); no maximum current is guaranteed. Highest tabulated value is 6.8 A at 50 psi.
Motor inductance and resistance not given (needed for freewheel and switch sizing).
Fuse type (fast/slow) not specified, only '10 Amp Recommended' (p1).
Lead numbering is not in the data sheet; pin names are the lead colours as printed ('Red +', 'Black').
